# Source: Decorated Bookbinding

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Decorated Bookbinding
- **Artist / culture:** Iran
- **Date:** 18th century
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** miniature painting
- **Department:** Arts of Asia
- **AIC artwork ID:** 13145
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/13145
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/3ee1fa49-d9c5-883d-1f01-1886f5149542/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Islamic Pattern

## Extracted source palette

`#B88818, #986818, #382818, #785818, #583818, #C8C8B8, #A89888, #E8E8D8`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#1D150C`
- `surface`: `#373028`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B88818`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#E8E8D8`
- `surface_variant`: `#373028`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#5A554E`
- `error`: `#B88818`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `16.95:1`, surface `12.22:1`
- Variant contrast: `12.22:1`
- Control contrast: `6.12:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
